- **TypeScript errors → report immediately.** If there are TS errors, list them under ALERTAS. Do not start implementing new features until errors are resolved (unless the user explicitly asks to proceed despite errors).

> 112	Sessão de execução do Sprint 4.1 (Canvas UX Mood Board completion) + um quick win crítico no fim. > 314:Sessão de fechamento de três grandes lacunas no AIOS de desenvolvimento, executadas em sequência sem rebuild ou interrupção do pipeline. Primeiro: o protocolo A2UI estava pronto há semanas mas faltava o último fio — a função `parseAgentMessage` definida em `useA2UI` nunca havia sido conectada ao callback de mensagem completada do `AIOSTerminal`. Toda resposta do agente que continha um bloco JSON com `type:"a2ui"` era silenciosamente descartada. A correção foi minimalista: adicionar `onMessage?: (content: string) => void` em `AIOSTerminalProps`, disparar `onMessage?.(ttsBufferRef.current)` no `useEffect` de fim de streaming antes do reset do buffer, e passar `parseAgentMessage` como `onMessage` do `<AIOSTerminal>` na `CoreV2Page`. Três linhas em dois arquivos. A2UI agora spawna superfícies dinâmicas (MetricsPanel, AgentStatusCard, SystemAlert, TextBlock) na coluna central da CoreV2Page automaticamente, sem intervenção manual. Segundo: cobertura de testes pulou de 66 para 122 com três suítes novas. `useOrchestrationGraph.test.ts` (21 tests) cobre runPipeline em todos os caminhos críticos — input vazio, transições mid-flight, sucesso completo com mapeamento step→nó, gate de mcoCoins (HTTP 402 → todos nós em `error`), erros parciais (gate-audit `error` → publishers `blocked`), e persistência de posições no localStorage. `useKnowledgeMesh.test.ts` (19 tests) valida `fetchLatestContext` multi-bucket com 7 priority types, dedup por ID, formato exato do `contextString` (header `[MESH_STATE]` + linhas `[TYPE] name (stability:X.XX): content[:200]`), `contextNodeIds`, `meshStats` com totalNodes/totalEdges/dominantTypes, garantia de que RLS isola tenants sem bypass de `user_id`, e ciclo de vida do canal Realtime (subscribe → unmount → removeChannel). `useSubscription.test.ts` (16 tests) cobre `checkout` sem user (toast + zero invoke), com user (Stripe redirect via `window.location.href`), error paths em `checkout` e `openPortal`, e transições de loading state. Padrão de mocking via `vi.hoisted` + `vi.mock` espelhando `phase-zeta.test.tsx`. Terceiro: o BoK Scribe Agent foi invocado em modo reverse-engineering para gerar a primeira família documental completa do projeto — 9 markdowns em `docs/bok/mcorch-constellation/` totalizando ~29.185 palavras, todas grounded em artefatos reais (177 src files, 30 migrations, 39 edge functions, 4 crons, 2564 nós, 122 testes). O BoK não inventa features: cada MR/BR/PR/FR cita um arquivo, função, tabela, RPC ou seção do HANDOFF. Onde o sistema rodando contradiz documentação prévia, o sistema vence — contradições viram doc-debt em `08-quality-metrics.md` (17 itens enumerados, 3 marcados ACTION REQUIRED por RPN > 100). O nó `bok-scribe-seal-mcorch-constellation-v1` (type `documentation_suite`, stability 0.85) foi inserido em `mcorch_nodes` via SQL editor do Supabase pelo Sovereign — embedding automático via `trg_mcorch_embed_on_insert`, BoK semanticamente recuperável pelo AIOS. Esta suíte é input obrigatório para futuras invocações de `/bok-agents-generator` (Phase 3 do plano BoK→Agents).

> 412:Sessão de correção de regressões visuais acumuladas após o DevOps + Security Seal. Cinco problemas identificados e resolvidos: layout de páginas full-canvas sobrepondo o sidebar, barra de busca conflitando com botão de auth, textos com opacidade reduzida dificultando leitura, e contagem de nós do painel Sovereign Mesh Control dessincronizada do HUD superior. Ponto de diagnóstico: `MatrixPage` e `MemoryPage` usavam `absolute inset-0` como container raiz — classe que posiciona relativo ao ancestral posicionado mais próximo (não o `<main>` do DashboardLayout), escapando do flex tree e sobrepondo sidebar e header. O padrão correto (`relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden`), já adotado por `ConstellationPage`, foi aplicado às duas páginas. Como consequência direta, a search bar (que estava em `absolute top-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2`) passou a ficar alinhada dentro do canvas — mas `left-1/2` do canvas com sidebar visível coincide com o fim dos badges. Solução: mover a search bar para dentro do flex row dos badges como item inline (`relative w-64`), com dropdown convertido de fluxo normal para `absolute top-full` para não empurrar outros badges. Para textos opacos: varredura em `ConstellationMatrix`, `MeshControlPanel` e `MemoryPage` — todas as classes `text-*/NN` com sufixo de opacidade em elementos de texto legível foram convertidas para variantes full-opacity. `MeshControlPanel` agora recebe `edgeCount` como prop adicional e exibe `nodeCount`/`edgeCount` do hook `useConstellationSigma` em vez dos totais do banco via `trigger-ingest`, garantindo paridade com o HUD superior.

> 587:Sessão de fechamento do ciclo de configuração do Usuário Zero. O ponto de partida era a SettingsPage acumulando dívida técnica: sem TanStack Query, model selector efêmero (perdido no refresh), chaves de usuário ignoradas pelas edge functions, tipos desincronizados, e mcoCoins subtraídos diretamente pelo cliente. >

> CONTAINER="mcorch_claude_mem"
> PORT=37777
> DATE=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
> COMPOSE_DIR="/home/gcrUX/htdocs/constellation-orchestra"
> 
> log() { echo "[$DATE] $1" >> "$LOG_FILE"; }
> 
> # Check if container is running
> if ! docker inspect --format='{{.State.Running}}' "$CONTAINER" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "true"; then
>     log "ALERT: $CONTAINER not running. Starting via docker compose..."
>     cd "$COMPOSE_DIR" && docker compose up -d mcorch-intelligence-node
>     log "Restart attempted."
>     HEALTH="unhealthy"
> else
>     # Ensure lock file exists (prevents false unhealthy state)
>     docker exec "$CONTAINER" touch /app/system/autonomic.lock 2>/dev/null
> 
>     # Check health status
>     HEALTH=$(docker inspect --format='{{.State.Health.Status}}' "$CONTAINER" 2>/dev/null)
>     if [ "$HEALTH" = "unhealthy" ]; then
>         log "ALERT: $CONTAINER is unhealthy. Restarting..."
>         docker restart "$CONTAINER"
>         log "Container restarted."
>     fi
> fi
> 
> log "Watchdog check completed. Status: ${HEALTH:-unknown}"
> 
> # ── Write health telemetry to Supabase for Neural HUD ────────────────────────
> # Load env vars (SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY)
> if [ -f "${COMPOSE_DIR}/.env" ]; then
>     # shellcheck disable=SC1090
>     set -a; source "${COMPOSE_DIR}/.env"; set +a
> fi
> 
> if [ -z "${SUPABASE_URL}" ] || [ -z "${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}" ]; then
>     log "WARNING: SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY not set — skipping telemetry write."
>     exit 0
> fi
> 
> # Check Chroma vector engine
> CHROMA_STATUS="unhealthy"
> if curl -sf "http://localhost:8001/api/v2/heartbeat" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
>     CHROMA_STATUS="healthy"
> fi
> 
> # Write a row per service (upsert-style: just insert, table keeps history)
> write_health() {
>     local SERVICE="$1"
>     local STATUS="$2"
>     curl -s -X POST "${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/infra_health_logs" \
>         -H "apikey: ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}" \
>         -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}" \
>         -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

> ### Fase 3 — Self-Heal Escalation (Watchdog Layer 2)
> 
> **Camada existente (não tocar):** `watchdog-mcorch.sh` faz restart automático na 1ª detecção.
> **Adição:** quando o status pós-restart continua `unhealthy` por **3 ciclos consecutivos** (15 minutos), o watchdog faz `POST http://127.0.0.1:18789/agents/engineer/invoke` com payload `{ "incident": "<container>", "telemetry_id": "<infra_health_logs.id>" }` — engineer agent investiga raiz, propõe fix, e pode comitar/deployar via tools bind.
> 
> **Implementação:**
> - Adicionar contador de falhas em `/tmp/mcorch-watchdog-fail-counter` (incrementa por unhealthy, reseta por healthy)
> - Quando counter ≥ 3 → escalar via curl ao gateway OpenClaw
> - Gravar evento em `infra_health_logs` com `severity=critical` + `escalated_to=openclaw-engineer`
> 
> **n8n note:** se houver instância n8n acessível (não confirmada nesta sessão), Stream Y futuro pode mover esse trigger para fluxo n8n declarativo. Por agora, escalation direta watchdog→gateway é suficiente e idempotente.

## 👤 User *(17:27:40)*

Base directory for this skill: /home/ubuntu/.claude/skills/firecrawl-map

# firecrawl map

Discover URLs on a site. Use `--search` to find a specific page within a large site.

## When to use

- You need to find a specific subpage on a large site
- You want a list of all URLs on a site before scraping or crawling
- Step 3 in the [workflow escalation pattern](firecrawl-cli): search → scrape → **map** → crawl → interact

## Quick start

```bash
# Find a specific page on a large site
firecrawl map "<url>" --search "authentication" -o .firecrawl/filtered.txt

# Get all URLs
firecrawl map "<url>" --limit 500 --json -o .firecrawl/urls.json
```

## Options

| Option                            | Description                  |
| --------------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `--limit <n>`                     | Max number of URLs to return |
| `--search <query>`                | Filter URLs by search query  |
| `--sitemap <include\|skip\|only>` | Sitemap handling strategy    |
| `--include-subdomains`            | Include subdomain URLs       |
| `--json`                          | Output as JSON               |
| `-o, --output <path>`             | Output file path             |

## Tips

- **Map + scrape is a common pattern**: use `map --search` to find the right URL, then `scrape` it.
- Example: `map https://docs.example.com --search "auth"` → found `/docs/api/authentication` → `scrape` that URL.

## See also

- [firecrawl-scrape](../firecrawl-scrape/SKILL.md) — scrape the URLs you discover
- [firecrawl-crawl](../firecrawl-crawl/SKILL.md) — bulk extract instead of map + scrape
- [firecrawl-download](../firecrawl-download/SKILL.md) — download entire site (uses map internally)

> 17	
> 18	## Quick Start
> 19	
> 20	### Basic Image Generation
> 21	
> 22	Here's a simple example to generate an image from a text prompt:
> 23	
> 24	```bash theme={null}
> 25	curl -X POST 'https://platform.higgsfield.ai/higgsfield-ai/soul/standard' \
> 26	  --header 'Authorization: Key {your_api_key}:{your_api_key_secret}' \
> 27	  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
> 28	  --header 'Accept: application/json' \
> 29	  --data '{
> 30	    "prompt": "A serene mountain landscape at sunset with vibrant orange and purple skies",
> 31	    "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
> 32	    "resolution": "720p"
> 33	  }'
> 34	```
> 35	
> 36	## Best Practices
> 37	
> 38	### Writing Effective Prompts
> 39	
> 40	* **Be specific**: Include details about style, mood, colors, and composition
> 41	* **Use descriptive language**: "A cozy mountain cabin at sunset with warm lighting" is better than "cabin"
> 42	* **Specify artistic style**: Mention styles like "photorealistic", "watercolor", "digital art", etc.
> 43	* **Include quality modifiers**: Terms like "highly detailed", "8k", "professional" can improve results
> 44	
> 45	### Example Prompts
> 46	
> 47	```text theme={null}
> 48	Good: "A professional photograph of a golden retriever puppy playing in a sunlit garden, shallow depth of field, bokeh background"
> 49	
> 50	Better: "Professional pet photography of a golden retriever puppy, 3 months old, playing with a red ball in a lush green garden, golden hour lighting, shallow depth of field, Canon EOS R5, 85mm lens, bokeh background"
> 51	```
> 52	
> 53	### Optimizing Generation
> 54	
> 55	* Start with lower resolutions for faster iterations
> 56	* Test different aspect ratios to find what works best for your use case
> 57	* Use webhooks for production workflows to avoid polling
> 58	* Store the `request_id` to retrieve results later if needed
> 59	
> 60	## Common Use Cases
> 61	
> 62	* **Marketing materials**: Product images, social media content, advertisements
> 63	* **Creative projects**: Concept art, illustrations, design mockups
> 64	* **Content creation**: Blog headers, thumbnails, visual storytelling
> 65	* **Prototyping**: Quick visualization of ideas and concepts
> 66

> 68	# Generate Videos from Images
> 69	Source: https://docs.higgsfield.ai/guides/video
> 70	
> 71	Learn how to transform static images into dynamic videos with Higgsfield API
> 72	
> 73	The Higgsfield API enables you to transform static images into dynamic, animated videos using state-of-the-art AI models. This powerful feature is perfect for creating engaging content for social media, marketing campaigns, presentations, and more.
> 74	
> 75	## Available Models
> 76

> 80	* `bytedance/seedance/v1/pro/image-to-video` - Professional-grade video generation
> 81	* `kling-video/v2.1/pro/image-to-video` - Advanced cinematic animations
> 82	* And many more...

> 128	## Best Practices
> 129	
> 130	### Writing Effective Motion Prompts
> 131	
> 132	* **Describe the movement**: Be specific about the type of motion you want (pan, zoom, rotation, etc.)
> 133	* **Set the pace**: Use words like "slowly", "quickly", "smoothly" to control animation speed
> 134	* **Specify camera movements**: Mention camera actions like "camera pans left", "zooms in", "orbits around"
> 135	* **Add atmospheric details**: Include environmental elements like "wind blowing", "water flowing", "lights flickering"
> 136	
> 137	### Example Prompts
> 138	
> 139	```text theme={null}
> 140	Good: "The camera slowly pans across the scene"
> 141	
> 142	Better: "Smooth cinematic camera pan from left to right, golden hour lighting, gentle wind rustling through leaves, shallow depth of field"
> 143	```
> 144	
> 145	### Image Preparation Tips
> 146	
> 147	* **Use high-quality source images**: Higher resolution inputs generally produce better results
> 148	* **Consider composition**: Images with clear subjects and good composition animate more effectively
> 149	* **Avoid heavy compression**: Use PNG or high-quality JPEG formats
> 150	* **Match aspect ratio**: Ensure your source image matches your desired video aspect ratio
> 151	
> 152	### Optimizing Generation
> 153	
> 154	* Start with shorter durations to iterate faster
> 155	* Test different models to find the best fit for your animation style
> 156	* Use webhooks for production workflows to avoid polling
> 157	* Store the `request_id` to retrieve results later if needed

> 169	# FAQ

> 171	
> 172	Frequently asked questions about Higgsfield API
> 173	
> 174	# Frequently Asked Questions
> 175	
> 176	<AccordionGroup>
> 177	  <Accordion title="What is the retention policy for generated output files?">
> 178	    Generated output files are stored and accessible for a minimum of 7 days from the time of creation. We strongly recommend downloading and storing files in your own infrastructure for long-term retention. Files may be removed from our servers at any time after the 7-day retention period.
> 179	  </Accordion>
> 180	
> 181	  <Accordion title="Are failed requests charged?">
> 182	    No. Failed generation requests are not charged to your account. You are only billed for successful completions. In the event of a failure, any credits or costs associated with that request are automatically refunded.
> 183	  </Accordion>
> 184	
> 185	  <Accordion title="What does NSFW status mean?">
> 186	    NSFW (Not Safe For Work) indicates that either your input parameters or the generated output did not pass our content moderation system due to content policy violations. Content policy rules and restrictions may vary depending on the specific model being used.
> 187	  </Accordion>
> 188	
> 189	  <Accordion title="Are NSFW-flagged requests charged?">
> 190	    No. Requests flagged as NSFW are not charged to your account. When content is rejected by our moderation system, any associated credits or costs are automatically refunded.
> 191	  </Accordion>
> 192	
> 193	  <Accordion title="Do you offer invoice-based billing?">
> 194	    Yes. Invoice-based payment options are available for enterprise customers and high-volume users. Please contact us at [support@higgsfield.ai](mailto:support@higgsfield.ai) to discuss custom billing arrangements.
> 195	  </Accordion>
> 196	
> 197	  <Accordion title="What are the API rate limits?">
> 198	    Rate limits vary based on your subscription plan and model usage. You can view your current rate limits and usage statistics in your [dashboard](https://cloud.higgsfield.ai). Contact our support team for information about increased rate limits for enterprise customers.
> 199	  </Accordion>
> 200	
> 201	  <Accordion title="How do I monitor my API usage?">
> 202	    You can monitor your API usage, credit consumption, and request history through the [Higgsfield Cloud dashboard](https://cloud.higgsfield.ai). The dashboard provides real-time analytics and detailed usage reports.
> 203	  </Accordion>
> 204	
> 205	  <Accordion title="Which programming languages are supported?">
> 206	    We currently provide an official Python SDK with full synchronous and asynchronous support. JavaScript/TypeScript SDK is coming soon. You can also integrate directly using our REST API from any language that supports HTTP requests. See our [Client Libraries](/how-to/sdk) documentation for more details.
> 207	  </Accordion>
> 208	
> 209	  <Accordion title="How do I get started with the API?">
> 210	    To get started:
> 211	
> 212	    1. Create an account at [cloud.higgsfield.ai](https://cloud.higgsfield.ai)
> 213	    2. Generate your API credentials from the dashboard
> 214	    3. Follow our [Quick Start Guide](/quickstart) for your first integration
> 215	    4. Explore our [API Documentation](/how-to/introduction) for detailed endpoint information
> 216	  </Accordion>
> 217	
> 218	  <Accordion title="What happens if a generation takes too long?">
> 219	    Generation requests have model-specific timeout limits. If a request exceeds the timeout, it will be marked as failed and you will not be charged. You can resubmit the request or contact support if you consistently experience timeout issues.
> 220	  </Accordion>
> 221	</AccordionGroup>

> 303	# How to use API
> 304	Source: https://docs.higgsfield.ai/how-to/introduction
> 305	
> 306	Complete guide to using the Higgsfield API
> 307	
> 308	## Overview
> 309	
> 310	The Model endpoint is the primary entry point for generating content with the Higgsfield API. Each model on the Higgsfield platform has a unique `model_id` (e.g., `higgsfield-ai/soul/standard`).
> 311	
> 312	**Base API URL:** `https://platform.higgsfield.ai`
> 313	
> 314	The Higgsfield API uses an asynchronous request-response pattern. When you submit a generation request, it enters a queue and processes in the background. This approach offers several advantages:
> 315	
> 316	* Monitor task status without maintaining open connections
> 317	* Cancel requests that haven't started processing
> 318	* Avoid resource-intensive concurrent connections
> 319	
> 320	## API Endpoints
> 321	
> 322	### Queue Management
> 323	
> 324	| Endpoint                                                      | Method | Description                                 |
> 325	| ------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------- |
> 326	| `https://platform.higgsfield.ai/{model_id}`                   | POST   | Submit a generation request to the queue    |
> 327	| `https://platform.higgsfield.ai/requests/{request_id}/status` | GET    | Retrieve the status of a generation request |
> 328	| `https://platform.higgsfield.ai/requests/{request_id}/cancel` | POST   | Cancel a pending request                    |
> 329	
> 330	### Parameters
> 331	
> 332	* **`model_id`**: The unique identifier for the model (e.g., `higgsfield-ai/soul/standard`)
> 333	* **`request_id`**: A unique UUID assigned to your request upon submission
> 334	
> 335	## Usage Examples
> 336	
> 337	### Submitting a Generation Request
> 338	
> 339	```bash theme={null}
> 340	curl -X POST 'https://platform.higgsfield.ai/higgsfield-ai/soul/standard' \
> 341	  --header 'Authorization: Key {your_api_key}:{your_api_key_secret}' \
> 342	  --data '{
> 343	    "prompt": "your prompt here",
> 344	    "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
> 345	    "resolution": "720p"
> 346	  }'
> 347	```
> 348	
> 349	### Response Format
> 350	
> 351	#### Queued Request
> 352	
> 353	```json theme={null}
> 354	{
> 355	  "status": "queued",
> 356	  "request_id": "d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff",
> 357	  "status_url": "https://platform.higgsfield.ai/requests/d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff/status",
> 358	  "cancel_url": "https://platform.higgsfield.ai/requests/d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff/cancel"
> 359	}
> 360	```
> 361	
> 362	#### Completed Request
> 363	
> 364	```json theme={null}
> 365	{
> 366	  "status": "completed",
> 367	  "request_id": "d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff",
> 368	  "status_url": "https://platform.higgsfield.ai/requests/d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff/status",
> 369	  "cancel_url": "https://platform.higgsfield.ai/requests/d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff/cancel",
> 370	  "images": [
> 371	    {
> 372	      "url": "https://image.url/example.jpg"
> 373	    }
> 374	  ],
> 375	  "video": {
> 376	    "url": "https://video.url/example.mp4"
> 377	  }
> 378	}
> 379	```
> 380	
> 381	## Request Statuses
> 382	
> 383	| Status        | Description                                                     |
> 384	| ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
> 385	| `queued`      | Request is waiting in the queue and has not started processing  |
> 386	| `in_progress` | Generation is actively processing (cancellation not available)  |
> 387	| `nsfw`        | Content failed moderation checks (credits refunded)             |
> 388	| `failed`      | Generation encountered an error (credits refunded)              |
> 389	| `completed`   | Generation finished successfully (media available for download) |
> 390	
> 391	## Canceling a Request
> 392	
> 393	You can cancel a request only while it remains in the `queued` status. Once processing begins, cancellation is no longer possible.
> 394	
> 395	```bash theme={null}
> 396	curl -X POST https://platform.higgsfield.ai/requests/{request_id}/cancel \
> 397	  --header 'Authorization: Key {your_api_key}:{your_api_key_secret}'
> 398	```
> 399	
> 400	If cancellation was successful, you will get a `202 Accepted` response status code. Otherwise, response status code will be `400 Bad Request`.
> 401	
> 402	## Best Practices
> 403	
> 404	* Poll the status endpoint periodically to check request progress
> 405	* Or use webhooks to get generation result by HTTP
> 406	* Store the `request_id` to retrieve results later
> 407	* Handle different status codes appropriately in your application
> 408	
> 409	
> 410	# Client Libraries
> 411	Source: https://docs.higgsfield.ai/how-to/sdk
> 412	
> 413	Official SDKs and client libraries for seamless integration with Higgsfield API
> 414	
> 415	Higgsfield provides official client libraries to simplify integration with our API. These libraries handle authentication, request management, and provide a developer-friendly interface for all platform features.
> 416	
> 417	## Supported Languages
> 418	
> 419	We currently support the following languages:
> 420	
> 421	<CardGroup>
> 422	  <Card title="Python" icon="python" href="https://pypi.org/project/higgsfield-client/">
> 423	    Full-featured SDK with sync and async support
> 424	  </Card>
> 425

> 427	    Coming soon

> 430

> 432	
> 433	## Python SDK
> 434	
> 435	The official Python SDK for [Higgsfield AI](https://cloud.higgsfield.ai). Supports both synchronous and asynchronous usage.
> 436	
> 437	### Installation
> 438	
> 439	Install the Higgsfield Python client using pip:
> 440	
> 441	```bash theme={null}
> 442	pip install higgsfield-client
> 443	```
> 444	
> 445	### Authentication
> 446	
> 447	Before using the client, set your API credentials as environment variables. You can use either a single key or separate API key and secret:
> 448	
> 449	**Option 1: Single Key**
> 450	
> 451	```bash theme={null}
> 452	export HF_KEY="your-api-key:your-api-secret"
> 453	```
> 454	
> 455	**Option 2: API Key + Secret**
> 456	
> 457	```bash theme={null}
> 458	export HF_API_KEY="your-api-key"
> 459	export HF_API_SECRET="your-api-secret"
> 460	```
> 461	
> 462	Get your credentials from the [Higgsfield Cloud](https://cloud.higgsfield.ai/).
> 463	
> 464	### Quick Start
> 465	
> 466	<CodeGroup>
> 467	  ```python sync icon="python" theme={null}
> 468	  import higgsfield_client
> 469	
> 470	  # Submit and wait for result
> 471	  result = higgsfield_client.subscribe(
> 472	      'higgsfield-ai/soul/standard',
> 473	      arguments={
> 474	          'prompt': 'A serene lake at sunset with mountains',
> 475	          'resolution': '2K',
> 476	          'aspect_ratio': '16:9',
> 477	          'camera_fixed': False
> 478	      }
> 479	  )
> 480	
> 481	  print(result['images'][0]['url'])
> 482	  ```
> 483	
> 484	  ```python async icon="python" theme={null}
> 485	  import asyncio
> 486	  import higgsfield_client
> 487	
> 488	  async def main():
> 489	      # Submit and wait for result
> 490	      result = await higgsfield_client.subscribe_async(
> 491	          'higgsfield-ai/soul/standard',
> 492	          arguments={
> 493	              'prompt': 'A serene lake at sunset with mountains',
> 494	              'resolution': '2K',
> 495	              'aspect_ratio': '16:9',
> 496	              'camera_fixed': False
> 497	          }
> 498	      )
> 499	
> 500	      print(result['images'][0]['url'])
> 501	
> 502	  asyncio.run(main())
> 503	  ```
> 504	</CodeGroup>
> 505	
> 506	## Usage Patterns
> 507	
> 508	### Pattern 1: Simple Submit and Wait
> 509	
> 510	Submit a request and wait for the result.
> 511	
> 512	<CodeGroup>
> 513	  ```python sync icon="python" theme={null}
> 514	  import higgsfield_client
> 515	
> 516	  result = higgsfield_client.subscribe(
> 517	      'higgsfield-ai/soul/standard',
> 518	      arguments={
> 519	          'prompt': 'A serene lake at sunset with mountains',
> 520	          'resolution': '2K',
> 521	          'aspect_ratio': '16:9',
> 522	          'camera_fixed': False
> 523	      }
> 524	  )
> 525	
> 526	  print(result['images'][0]['url'])
> 527	  ```
> 528	
> 529	  ```python async icon="python" theme={null}
> 530	  import asyncio
> 531	  import higgsfield_client
> 532	
> 533	  async def main():
> 534	      result = await higgsfield_client.subscribe_async(
> 535	          'higgsfield-ai/soul/standard',
> 536	          arguments={
> 537	              'prompt': 'A serene lake at sunset with mountains',
> 538	              'resolution': '2K',
> 539	              'aspect_ratio': '16:9',
> 540	              'camera_fixed': False
> 541	          }
> 542	      )
> 543	      
> 544	      print(result['images'][0]['url'])
> 545	
> 546	  asyncio.run(main())
> 547	  ```
> 548	</CodeGroup>
> 549	
> 550	### Pattern 2: Submit and Track Progress
> 551	
> 552	Submit a request and monitor its status in real-time.
> 553	
> 554	<CodeGroup>
> 555	  ```python sync icon="python" theme={null}
> 556	  import higgsfield_client
> 557	
> 558	  request_controller = higgsfield_client.submit(
> 559	      'higgsfield-ai/soul/standard',
> 560	      arguments={
> 561	          'prompt': 'Football ball',
> 562	          'resolution': '2K',
> 563	          'aspect_ratio': '16:9',
> 564	          'camera_fixed': False
> 565	      },
> 566	      webhook_url='https://example.com/webhook'  # Optional webhook
> 567	  )
> 568	
> 569	  for status in request_controller.poll_request_status():
> 570	      if isinstance(status, higgsfield_client.Queued):
> 571	          print('Queued')
> 572	      elif isinstance(status, higgsfield_client.InProgress):
> 573	          print('In progress')
> 574	      elif isinstance(status, higgsfield_client.Completed):
> 575	          print('Completed')
> 576	      elif isinstance(status, (higgsfield_client.Failed, higgsfield_client.NSFW, higgsfield_client.Cancelled)):
> 577	          print('Oops!')
> 578	
> 579	  result = request_controller.get()
> 580	  print(result['images'][0]['url'])
> 581	  ```
> 582	
> 583	  ```python async icon="python" theme={null}
> 584	  import asyncio
> 585	  import higgsfield_client
> 586	
> 587	  async def main():
> 588	      request_controller = await higgsfield_client.submit_async(
> 589	          'higgsfield-ai/soul/standard',
> 590	          arguments={
> 591	              'prompt': 'Football ball',
> 592	              'resolution': '2K',
> 593	              'aspect_ratio': '16:9',
> 594	              'camera_fixed': False
> 595	          },
> 596	          webhook_url='https://example.com/webhook'
> 597	      )
> 598	
> 599	      async for status in request_controller.poll_request_status():
> 600	          if isinstance(status, higgsfield_client.Queued):
> 601	              print('Queued')
> 602	          elif isinstance(status, higgsfield_client.InProgress):
> 603	              print('In progress')
> 604	          elif isinstance(status, higgsfield_client.Completed):
> 605	              print('Completed')
> 606	          elif isinstance(status, (higgsfield_client.Failed, higgsfield_client.NSFW, higgsfield_client.Cancelled)):
> 607	              print('Oops!')
> 608	
> 609	      result = await request_controller.get()
> 610	      print(result['images'][0]['url'])
> 611	
> 612	  asyncio.run(main())
> 613	  ```
> 614	</CodeGroup>
> 615	
> 616	### Pattern 3: Submit with Callbacks
> 617	
> 618	Use callbacks to handle status updates.
> 619	
> 620	<CodeGroup>
> 621	  ```python sync icon="python" theme={null}
> 622	  import higgsfield_client
> 623	
> 624	  def on_enqueue(request_id):
> 625	      print(f'Request {request_id} was enqueued')
> 626	
> 627	  def on_status_update(status):
> 628	      print(f'Status: {status}')
> 629	
> 630	  result = higgsfield_client.subscribe(
> 631	      'higgsfield-ai/soul/standard',
> 632	      arguments={
> 633	          'prompt': 'A serene lake at sunset with mountains',
> 634	          'resolution': '2K',
> 635	          'aspect_ratio': '16:9',
> 636	          'camera_fixed': False
> 637	      },
> 638	      on_enqueue=on_enqueue,
> 639	      on_queue_update=on_status_update
> 640	  )
> 641	  ```
> 642	
> 643	  ```python async icon="python" theme={null}
> 644	  import asyncio
> 645	  import higgsfield_client
> 646	
> 647	  def on_enqueue(request_id):
> 648	      print(f'Request {request_id} was enqueued')
> 649	
> 650	  def on_status_update(status):
> 651	      print(f'Status: {status}')
> 652	
> 653	  async def main():
> 654	      await higgsfield_client.subscribe_async(
> 655	          'higgsfield-ai/soul/standard',
> 656	          arguments={
> 657	              'prompt': 'A serene lake at sunset with mountains',
> 658	              'resolution': '2K',
> 659	              'aspect_ratio': '16:9',
> 660	              'camera_fixed': False
> 661	          },
> 662	          on_enqueue=on_enqueue,
> 663	          on_queue_update=on_status_update
> 664	      )
> 665	
> 666	  asyncio.run(main())
> 667	  ```
> 668	</CodeGroup>
> 669	
> 670	### Pattern 4: Manage Existing Requests
> 671	
> 672	Work with request controllers to manage requests.
> 673	
> 674	<CodeGroup>
> 675	  ```python sync icon="python" theme={null}
> 676	  import higgsfield_client
> 677	
> 678	  request_controller = higgsfield_client.submit(
> 679	      'higgsfield-ai/soul/standard',
> 680	      arguments={
> 681	          'prompt': 'A serene lake at sunset with mountains',
> 682	          'resolution': '2K',
> 683	          'aspect_ratio': '16:9',
> 684	          'camera_fixed': False
> 685	      },
> 686	      webhook_url='https://example.com/webhook'
> 687	  )
> 688	
> 689	  # Check status
> 690	  status = request_controller.status()
> 691	
> 692	  # Wait for completion and get result
> 693	  result = request_controller.get()
> 694	
> 695	  # Cancel a queued request
> 696	  request_controller.cancel()
> 697	  ```
> 698	
> 699	  ```python async icon="python" theme={null}

> 701	  import higgsfield_client

> 705	          'higgsfield-ai/soul/standard',

> 717

> 720	
> 721	      # Cancel a queued request

> 808	# Webhook Integration
> 809	Source: https://docs.higgsfield.ai/how-to/webhooks
> 810	
> 811	Guide to using webhooks with the Higgsfield API
> 812	
> 813	## Overview
> 814	
> 815	Webhooks allow you to receive automatic notifications when your generation requests reach a final status. Instead of polling the status endpoint, the Higgsfield API will send an HTTP POST request to your specified webhook URL.
> 816	
> 817	## Configuration
> 818	
> 819	To enable webhook notifications, include the `hf_webhook` query parameter in your generation request with your webhook endpoint URL.
> 820	
> 821	### Example Request
> 822	
> 823	```bash theme={null}
> 824	curl -X POST 'https://platform.higgsfield.ai/higgsfield-ai/soul/standard?hf_webhook=https://webhook.url/example' \
> 825	  --header 'Authorization: Key {your_api_key}:{your_api_key_secret}' \
> 826	  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
> 827	  --header 'Accept: application/json' \
> 828	  --data '{
> 829	    "prompt": "your prompt here",
> 830	    "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
> 831	    "resolution": "720p"
> 832	  }'
> 833	```
> 834	
> 835	## Webhook Notifications
> 836	
> 837	Your webhook endpoint will receive an HTTP POST request when the generation reaches a final status: `completed`, `failed`, or `nsfw`.
> 838	
> 839	### Completed Status
> 840	
> 841	#### Image Generation
> 842	
> 843	```json theme={null}
> 844	{
> 845	  "status": "completed",
> 846	  "request_id": "9417a243-e457-4075-895b-b68f3cda5303",
> 847	  "status_url": "https://platform.higgsfield.ai/requests/9417a243-e457-4075-895b-b68f3cda5303/status",
> 848	  "cancel_url": "https://platform.higgsfield.ai/requests/9417a243-e457-4075-895b-b68f3cda5303/cancel",
> 849	  "images": [
> 850	    {
> 851	      "url": "https://images.url/example"
> 852	    }
> 853	  ]
> 854	}
> 855	```
> 856	
> 857	#### Video Generation
> 858	
> 859	```json theme={null}
> 860	{
> 861	  "status": "completed",
> 862	  "request_id": "9417a243-e457-4075-895b-b68f3cda5303",
> 863	  "status_url": "https://platform.higgsfield.ai/requests/9417a243-e457-4075-895b-b68f3cda5303/status",
> 864	  "cancel_url": "https://platform.higgsfield.ai/requests/9417a243-e457-4075-895b-b68f3cda5303/cancel",
> 865	  "video": {
> 866	    "url": "https://video.url/example"
> 867	  }
> 868	}
> 869	```
> 870	
> 871	### Failed Status
> 872	
> 873	```json theme={null}
> 874	{
> 875	  "status": "failed",
> 876	  "request_id": "9417a243-e457-4075-895b-b68f3cda5303",
> 877	  "error": "Generation fail message"
> 878	}
> 879	```
> 880	
> 881	### NSFW Status
> 882	
> 883	```json theme={null}
> 884	{
> 885	  "status": "nsfw",
> 886	  "request_id": "9417a243-e457-4075-895b-b68f3cda5303"
> 887	}
> 888	```
> 889	
> 890	## Retry Logic
> 891	
> 892	The Higgsfield API implements automatic retry logic to ensure reliable webhook delivery:
> 893	
> 894	* Webhooks will be retried for up to **2 hours** after the initial delivery attempt
> 895	* Retries continue until your endpoint returns a successful response (HTTP `2xx` status code)
> 896	* If your endpoint remains unavailable or continues to return error responses after 2 hours, retry attempts will cease
> 897	* You can still retrieve the generation results by polling the `status_url` if webhook delivery fails
> 898	
> 899	### Handling Retries
> 900	
> 901	To minimize unnecessary retries:
> 902	
> 903	* Ensure your webhook endpoint is highly available
> 904	* Return a `2xx` status code promptly upon successful receipt
> 905	* Implement idempotency using the `request_id` to handle duplicate notifications
> 906	* Log received webhooks to track delivery patterns
> 907	
> 908	## Webhook Requirements
> 909	
> 910	* Your webhook endpoint must accept HTTP POST requests
> 911	* Your endpoint should respond with a `2xx` status code to acknowledge receipt
> 912	* The webhook payload will be sent as JSON in the request body
> 913	* Ensure your endpoint is publicly accessible and can handle the expected request volume
> 914	
> 915	## Best Practices
> 916	
> 917	* Implement proper error handling for webhook deliveries
> 918	* Validate the `request_id` to ensure the notification matches your records
> 919	* Store webhook payloads for audit and debugging purposes
> 920	* Use HTTPS endpoints for secure data transmission
> 921	* Respond quickly to webhook requests (under 10 seconds) to avoid timeouts
> 922	* Implement idempotency checks to safely handle duplicate webhook deliveries during retries
> 923

The platform brings together hundreds of specialized models for image, video, voice, and audio generation, making them available through a streamlined programmatic interface.

Considerar adicionar como 3\u00aa op\u00e7\u00e3o no cat\u00e1logo do n\u00f3 ImageToVideo.\n\n---\n\n## Request shape \u2014 Soul (text-to-image)\n\n```bash\nPOST https://platform.higgsfield.ai/higgsfield-ai/soul/standard\nAuthorization: Key {key}:{secret}\nContent-Type: application/json\nAccept: application/json\n\n{\n  \"prompt\": \"string\",\n  \"aspect_ratio\": \"16:9\" | \"9:16\" | \"1:1\" | \"4:5\",\n  \"resolution\": \"720p\" | \"1080p\" | \"2K\"\n}\n```\n\nAdicionais detectados via SDK Python (`higgsfield_client`):\n- `camera_fixed: bool` \u2014 controla movimento da c\u00e2mera mesmo em imagem est\u00e1tica (provavelmente afeta o pose canvas)\n\n## Request shape \u2014 DoP / Kling (image-to-video)\n\n```bash\nPOST https://platform.higgsfield.ai/higgsfield-ai/dop/standard\nAuthorization: Key {key}:{secret}\nContent-Type: application/json\nAccept: application/json\n\n{\n  \"image_url\": \"https://...\",\n  \"prompt\": \"string\",\n  \"duration\": 5    # DoP aceita 5; Kling e Seedance podem variar\n}\n```\n\n\u26a0\ufe0f **OTD-HF-003:** Docs can\u00f4nicas s\u00f3 mostram exemplos com `duration: 5`. O plano `floating-sleeping-sparrow.md` menciona 5/10/15s \u2014 confirmar via `cloud.higgsfield.ai/explore` (Models Gallery) ou via support se DoP suporta 10s/15s. Pricing tabulado s\u00f3 lista 5s para DoP.\n\nPar\u00e2metros avan\u00e7ados (motion strength, aspect ratio, resolution para v\u00eddeo) **n\u00e3o est\u00e3o documentados na llms-full** \u2014 provavelmente expostos no api-reference detalhado (n\u00e3o capturado nesta sess\u00e3o). Recomenda\u00e7\u00e3o: usar `image_url` + `prompt` + `duration` no v1; investigar params avan\u00e7ados via `/docs/api-reference` numa Phase 4.3 follow-up.\n\n---\n\n## Response shape\n\n### Queued (HTTP 200)\n```json\n{\n  \"status\": \"queued\",\n  \"request_id\": \"d7e6c0f3-6699-4f6c-bb45-2ad7fd9158ff\",\n  \"status_url\": \"https://platform.higgsfield.ai/requests/.../status\",\n  \"cancel_url\": \"https://platform.higgsfield.ai/requests/.../cancel\"\n}\n```\n\n### Completed (poll ou webhook)\n```json\n{\n  \"status\": \"completed\",\n  \"request_id\": \"...\",\n  \"status_url\": \"...\",\n  \"cancel_url\": \"...\",\n  \"images\": [{ \"url\": \"...\" }],      // se image gen\n  \"video\":  { \"url\": \"...\" }          // se video gen\n}\n```\n\n### Failed / NSFW\n```json\n{\n  \"status\": \"failed\" | \"nsfw\",\n  \"request_id\": \"...\",\n  \"error\": \"Generation fail message\"    // apenas em failed\n}\n```\n\n### Estados poss\u00edveis\n\n| Status | Significado | Cr\u00e9dito |\n|--------|-------------|---------|\n| `queued` | Na fila | reservado |\n| `in_progress` | Processando (n\u00e3o-cancel\u00e1vel) | reservado |\n| `completed` | Conclu\u00eddo com sucesso | **cobrado** |\n| `failed` | Erro t\u00e9cnico | **refund autom\u00e1tico** |\n| `nsfw` | Bloqueado por modera\u00e7\u00e3o | **refund autom\u00e1tico** |\n\n\u2705 **Confirma o invariante do plano:** debitar `mco_balance` SOMENTE ap\u00f3s `completed` + upload OK. Failed/NSFW = sem cobran\u00e7a (refund \u00e9 autom\u00e1tico no lado Higgsfield).\n\n---\n\n## Webhook spec \u2014 DIVERG\u00caNCIA CR\u00cdTICA\n\n### Como passar a URL do webhook \u2757\n\n**N\u00e3o \u00e9 via body.** A URL \u00e9 passada como **query parameter** `hf_webhook` na URL do submit:\n\n```bash\nPOST 'https://platform.higgsfield.ai/higgsfield-ai/soul/standard?hf_webhook=https://my.endpoint/callback'\nAuthorization: Key {key}:{secret}\n...\n```\n\n**Implica\u00e7\u00e3o no c\u00f3digo:**\n\n```typescript\n// _shared/higgsfield.ts (Deno) \u2014 pseudoc\u00f3digo\nasync function submitVideoJob(opts: {\n  modelPath: string;       // \"higgsfield-ai/dop/standard\"\n  imageUrl: string;\n  prompt: string;\n  duration: number;\n  webhookUrl: string;\n  apiKey: string;\n  apiSecret: string;\n}) {\n  const submitUrl = new URL(`https://platform.higgsfield.ai/${opts.modelPath}`);\n  submitUrl.searchParams.set(\"hf_webhook\", opts.webhookUrl);   // \u2190 query param\n\n  const res = await fetch(submitUrl.toString(), {\n    method: \"POST\",\n    headers: {\n      \"Authorization\": `Key ${opts.apiKey}:${opts.apiSecret}`,\n      \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n      \"Accept\": \"application/json\",\n    },\n    body: JSON.stringify({\n      image_url: opts.imageUrl,\n      prompt: opts.prompt,\n      duration: opts.duration,\n    }),\n  });\n  // ...\n}\n```\n\n### Webhook payload (recebido pelo Edge Function MCORCH)\n\nPOST request, JSON body, **sem assinatura HMAC** (docs n\u00e3o mencionam nenhum mecanismo de signing).\n\n```json\n// Completed (image)\n{ \"status\": \"completed\", \"request_id\": \"...\", \"status_url\": \"...\", \"cancel_url\": \"...\", \"images\": [{\"url\": \"...\"}] }\n\n// Completed (video)\n{ \"status\": \"completed\", \"request_id\": \"...\", \"status_url\": \"...\", \"cancel_url\": \"...\", \"video\": {\"url\": \"...\"} }\n\n// Failed\n{ \"status\": \"failed\", \"request_id\": \"...\", \"error\": \"...\" }\n\n// NSFW\n{ \"status\": \"nsfw\", \"request_id\": \"...\" }\n```\n\n### Retry policy\n\n- **2 horas** de retry at\u00e9 resposta 2xx\n- Se endpoint continuar falhando, retries cessam \u2014 `status_url` continua dispon\u00edvel para polling manual\n- **MUST** retornar `2xx` para acknowledgment (sob 10s)\n\n### Idempot\u00eancia\n\n- Higgsfield pode entregar o mesmo webhook m\u00faltiplas vezes durante retries\n- **Edge Function MUST** ser idempotente via `request_id`:\n  ```sql\n  -- pseudoc\u00f3digo\n  UPDATE vm_canvas_jobs\n  SET status = 'completed', result_url = ..., updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE higgsfield_request_id = $1 AND status = 'pending';\n  -- Se status j\u00e1 = 'completed', UPDATE retorna 0 rows e nada acontece\n  ```\n\n### \u26a0\ufe0f Webhook auth \u2014 Higgsfield N\u00c3O assina o callback\n\n**Recomenda\u00e7\u00e3o MCORCH:** proteger o endpoint via **token embutido na URL** do webhook:\n\n```typescript\n// Quando faz submit:\nconst webhookUrl = `${Deno.env.get(\"SUPABASE_URL\")}/functions/v1/higgsfield-webhook?token=${Deno.env.get(\"HIGGSFIELD_WEBHOOK_SECRET\")}`;\n```\n\n```typescript\n// No edge function higgsfield-webhook:\nconst token = new URL(req.url).searchParams.get(\"token\");\nif (token !== Deno.env.get(\"HIGGSFIELD_WEBHOOK_SECRET\")) {\n  return new Response(\"Forbidden\", { status: 403 });\n}\n```\n\n`HIGGSFIELD_WEBHOOK_SECRET` \u00e9 um **secret novo no vault Supabase**, gerado uma vez (ex: `openssl rand -hex 32`). Engineer agent \u00e9 owner desse secret.\n\n---\n\n## Pricing (CONFIRMADO via /docs/pricing)\n\n**Convers\u00e3o:** `$1 USD = 16 credits` \u00b7 pay-as-you-go \u00b7 sem m\u00ednimo de volume\n\n### Soul (Text-to-Image)\n\n| Quality | Batch | Credits | USD | Coment\u00e1rio |\n|---------|-------|---------|-----|-----|\n| 720p | 1 | 1.5 | $0.09 | menor custo de valida\u00e7\u00e3o |\n| 720p | 4 | 2 | $0.13 | batch dilui custo unit\u00e1rio |\n| 1080p | 1 | 3 | $0.19 | preview hi-res |\n| 1080p | 4 | 5 | $0.31 | mood board completo |\n\n### DoP (Image-to-Video, 5s)\n\n| Variant | Credits | USD | Notas |\n|---------|---------|-----|-------|\n| Lite | 2 | $0.125 | velocidade b\u00e1sica |\n| Turbo | 6.5 | $0.406 | 2\u00d7 r\u00e1pido, fila priorit\u00e1ria |\n| Standard | 9 | $0.563 | melhor qualidade, fila priorit\u00e1ria |\n\n### Character (Soul ID)\n\n40 credits = $2.50 \u2014 cria\u00e7\u00e3o de personagem reutiliz\u00e1vel (Phase 4.5 / p\u00f3s-C4)\n\n### Speak V2 (Speech-to-Video) \u2014 fora do escopo Phase 4.2\n\nMid/High \u00d7 5/10/15s \u2014 n\u00e3o usado no Canvas Studio v1.\n\n### \u26a0\ufe0f OTD-HF-004: Kling 2.1 Pro pricing\n\nN\u00e3o tabulado em `/docs/pricing` (p\u00e1gina foca em modelos Higgsfield pr\u00f3prios). Kling \u00e9 third-party. Capturar pricing via:\n- `cloud.higgsfield.ai/explore` (Models Gallery)\n- `/docs/api-reference/image-to-video/generate-using-kling-2-1-pro` (n\u00e3o verificado)\n- Suporte (`support@higgsfield.ai`)\n\nSugerido para Phase 4.2: usar **placeholder de 12 credits / 5s** baseado no padr\u00e3o DoP Standard (9 cr) + premium markup. **Confirmar no Cloud Dashboard antes de cobrar mcoCoins por essa via.**\n\n---\n\n## Cobran\u00e7a & Refund (\u2705 alinhado com o plano)\n\n- \u2705 **Failed/NSFW = refund autom\u00e1tico** no lado Higgsfield. Cliente MCORCH s\u00f3 precisa N\u00c3O debitar `mco_balance` quando webhook chegar com status != `completed`.\n- \u2705 Sovereign n\u00e3o paga por requests cancelados via `/cancel` em `queued`.\n- \u2705 Arquivos resultantes **s\u00f3 retidos por 7 dias** no Higgsfield. **MCORCH precisa baixar imediatamente ap\u00f3s `completed`** para o bucket `canvas-assets` (lifetime do Sovereign).\n\n### Invariante de billing (alinhado com `floating-sleeping-sparrow.md`)\n\n```\nSubmit (canvas-execute):\n  \u2514\u2500\u2500 INSERT vm_canvas_jobs (status='pending', N\u00c3O debita mco_balance)\n\nWebhook (higgsfield-webhook):\n  \u251c\u2500\u2500 status='completed':\n  \u2502     \u251c\u2500\u2500 Download bytes do result_url Higgsfield\n  \u2502     \u251c\u2500\u2500 Upload para bucket 'canvas-assets'  (se falhar \u2192 status='failed', sem d\u00e9bito)\n  \u2502     \u251c\u2500\u2500 deduct_mco_coins(user_id, coin_cost)   \u2190 d\u00e9bito at\u00f4mico aqui\n  \u2502     \u251c\u2500\u2500 INSERT vm_canvas_executions + vm_canvas_assets\n  \u2502     \u2514\u2500\u2500 UPDATE vm_canvas_jobs (status='completed', result_url=...)\n  \u2502\n  \u251c\u2500\u2500 status='failed' OU 'nsfw':\n  \u2502     \u2514\u2500\u2500 UPDATE vm_canvas_jobs (status=<status>, error=...)\n  \u2502     (Higgsfield refund \u00e9 autom\u00e1tico; nada a fazer no nosso lado)\n  \u2502\n  \u2514\u2500\u2500 (Idempot\u00eancia: UPDATE somente quando job.status='pending')\n```\n\n---\n\n## Best Practices observadas (consolidar no client Deno)\n\n1. **Polling fallback:** se webhook falhar (2h sem 2xx), client deve poder fazer poll manual de `status_url`. Engineer agent monitora `vm_canvas_jobs.status='pending'` com `created_at > 2h ago` e dispara poll de recovery.\n2. **Resposta r\u00e1pida do webhook:** \u2264 10s para acknowledgment. N\u00e3o fazer upload s\u00edncrono dentro do handler \u2014 usar `queueMicrotask` ou Supabase Edge Background Tasks.\n3. **HTTPS obrigat\u00f3rio** \u2014 Supabase Edge Functions j\u00e1 HTTPS por padr\u00e3o. \u2705\n4. **`request_id` como identidade can\u00f4nica** \u2014 usar como chave prim\u00e1ria de idempot\u00eancia em `vm_canvas_jobs.higgsfield_request_id` (UNIQUE constraint na migration).\n\n---\n\n## Deltas vs. `canvas-execute/index.ts` corrente (commit `1209738`)\n\n| Componente | Estado atual | A\u00e7\u00e3o Phase 5 |\n|------------|--------------|--------------|\n| Base URL `platform.higgsfield.ai` | \u2705 correto | manter |\n| Auth `Key key:secret` | \u2705 correto | manter |\n| Soul endpoint `/higgsfield-ai/soul/standard` | \u2705 correto | manter |\n| Submit + poll pattern | \u2705 correto | manter |\n| RPC `deduct_mco_coins` (n\u00e3o `deduct_mco_balance`) | \u2705 corrigido em `1209738` | manter |\n| Webhook param no body | \u274c usar **query param** `?hf_webhook=` | refatorar em `_shared/higgsfield.ts` |\n| DoP endpoint `preview` vs `standard` | \u2753 confirmar uso | usar `standard` como can\u00f4nico |\n| Webhook secret token | \u274c n\u00e3o existe | criar `HIGGSFIELD_WEBHOOK_SECRET` no vault |\n| Higgsfield credit balance UI | \u274c n\u00e3o existe | investigar endpoint `/credits/balance` ou similar (n\u00e3o documentado na llms-full) |\n| Kling pricing | \u274c desconhecido | placeholder 12 cr / 5s; > 373	async function generateHiggsfield(apiKey: string, apiSecret: string, body: ExecuteRequest) {
> 374	  if (!apiKey || !apiSecret) {

> 378	  // Correct Higgsfield Platform API — base + auth + routes per the tested

> 383	  const POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 3000;
> 384	  const MAX_POLL_MS = 90_000;
> 385

> 388	    "1024x1024": "1:1",

> 391	  };
> 392	  const sizeKey = body.parameters?.size ? String(body.parameters.size) : "";
> 393	  const aspectRatio = body.parameters?.aspect_ratio || SIZE_TO_AR[sizeKey] || "1:1";
> 394	  const resolution = body.parameters?.resolution === "720p" ? "720p" : "1080p";
> 395	
> 396	  // ── Submit Soul text-to-image job ──────────────────────────────────
> 397	  const submitResp = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}/higgsfield-ai/soul/standard`, {

> 401	      "Content-Type": "application/json",

> 404	    body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: body.prompt, aspect_ratio: aspectRatio, resolution }),
> 405	  });

> 407	  if (!submitResp.ok) {

> 410	      throw new Error("Higgsfield: credenciais inválidas");

> 412	    if (submitResp.status === 402) {
> 413	      throw new Error("Higgsfield: saldo de créditos esgotado");
> 414	    }
> 415	    if (submitResp.status === 429) {

> 440	      if (!url) throw new Error("Higgsfield: geração concluída sem URL de saída");

> **Camada existente (não tocar):** `watchdog-mcorch.sh` faz restart automático na 1ª detecção.
> **Adição:** quando o status pós-restart continua `unhealthy` por **3 ciclos consecutivos** (15 minutos), o watchdog faz `POST http://127.0.0.1:18789/agents/engineer/invoke` com payload `{ "incident": "<container>", "telemetry_id": "<infra_health_logs.id>" }` — engineer agent investiga raiz, propõe fix, e pode comitar/deployar via tools bind.
> 
> **Implementação:**
> - Adicionar contador de falhas em `/tmp/mcorch-watchdog-fail-counter` (incrementa por unhealthy, reseta por healthy)
> - Quando counter ≥ 3 → escalar via curl ao gateway OpenClaw
> - Gravar evento em `infra_health_logs` com `severity=critical` + `escalated_to=openclaw-engineer`
> 
> **n8n note:** se houver instância n8n acessível (não confirmada nesta sessão), Stream Y futuro pode mover esse trigger para fluxo n8n declarativo. Por agora, escalation direta watchdog→gateway é suficiente e idempotente.
> 
> **Files:**
> - `scripts/watchdog-mcorch.sh` (extensão — preservar comportamento atual)
> - `.claude/context/openclaw-self-heal-runbook.md` (novo — runbook do incident response)
>
